results.title: RECO Board Appoints Jean Lépine Interim Chief Executive Officer
results.content:
TORONTO, Sept. 9, 2026 /CNW/ -- The Board of Directors of the Real Estate Council of Ontario (RECO) today announced the appointment of Jean Lépine as Interim Chief Executive Officer (CEO) as the regulator advances its multi-year transformation.

Lépine has served as RECO's Acting CEO since the end of December 2025. His appointment as Interim CEO coincides with the transition of governance authority to RECO's new independent, skills-based Board of Directors. [...] Accessibility Statement Skip Navigation

results.title: RECO appoints Jean Lépine interim CEO
results.content:
REM

REM 

  has appointed Jean Lépine as interim CEO, just one day after his term as administrator of the regulator came to an end.

Lépine has also served as RECO’s acting CEO since the end of December 2025. His appointment as interim CEO comes as governance authority transitions to RECO’s new independent, skills-based board of directors, according to a RECO news release issued Sept. 9. [...] The appointment means Lépine will remain at the regulator as it continues a multi-year transformation that began during his tenure as administrator.

## Lépine remains as RECO transitions to new board

Lépine was appointed administrator last November, assuming control of RECO during the fallout from the iPro Realty Ltd. trust account controversy. [...] His appointment as administrator officially ended Sept. 8 after Ontario Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement Minister Stephen Crawford accepted his recommendation to return RECO to board governance. The new board assumed authority Sept. 9.

As REM reported last week, Lépine said at the time that RECO was ready to move forward under its new board following months of changes at the regulator. Among the board’s first priorities was appointing a CEO.

## Social Sharing

The Ford government announced Friday it has appointed an administrator to take control of the Real Estate Council of Ontario (RECO), following an independent audit into the real estate regulator’s handling of what it describes as iPro Realty's "misappropriation" of funds. [...] "Our shared goal is to ensure a smooth transition and to continue to drive the necessary reforms already underway at RECO, arising from Dentons’ independent report," the spokesperson said in the statement to CBC News.

Jean Lépine has been appointed as the administrator to take over the Real Estate Council of Ontario from Dec. 1.(Evan Mitsui/CBC)
